title: FAISS IVF-PQ and ANN index cascade
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for k-means++ Voronoi inverted-file partitioning, residual uint8 product quantization, asymmetric distance lookup tables and exact top-R reranking.
boundaries: ProductQuantizedIvfIndex partitions R^D vectors across nlist Voronoi cells via deterministic k-means++, quantizes residual subvectors into compact uint8 PQ codes and evaluates queries via Asymmetric Distance Computation (ADC) lookup tables.
Exact dense L2 reranking executes strictly on the shortlisted top-R ADC candidates when enabled by the active NodeGrid regime.
All index topology, codebook, probing and rerank parameters resolve from default_grid_spec.json with zero inline magic literals.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for k-means++ Voronoi inverted-file partitioning, residual uint8 product quantization, asymmetric distance lookup tables and exact top-R reranking

value.lets_workers: Fit deterministic k-means++ coarse Voronoi quantizers (nlist cells) and M residual product-quantization sub-codebooks (K_sub centroids per subspace), pack vectors into M-byte uint8 PQ codes, run Asymmetric Distance Computation (ADC) table lookups across nprobe cells with optional exact top-R reranking, and benchmark memory compression vs Recall@k across fast_compact and high_recall grid cells.

flow.when: Train coarse Voronoi centroids and M residual subspace codebooks via deterministic k-means++ and encode indexed vectors as compact M-byte uint8 PQ codes.
Evaluate nprobe Asymmetric Distance Computation lookup tables and exact top-R rerank cascades across fast_compact and high_recall grid cells against brute-force ground truth.
Independently verify byte compression ratios, Recall@k progression and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: 192-vector 32-D IVF-PQ cascade benchmark recomputed in test_ivf_pq_cascade.py: fast_compact packs 4 uint8 bytes/vector (64.0x compression vs float64, 32.0x vs float32, scanning 24.0 vectors/query with 0 exact reranks, Recall@5 = 0.533333), while high_recall packs 8 uint8 bytes/vector (32.0x vs float64, 16.0x vs float32, scanning 96.0 ADC candidates and reranking top 20, achieving Recall@5 = 1.0).

nouns.title: Guardrail: vector dimensions must divide evenly across M subspaces and K_sub centroids must fit uint8 storage
nouns.category_reason: Preserves lossless subspace slicing and 1-byte-per-subspace PQ code layout.

value.rule: Require dim % subspaces_m == 0, 1 <= subspace_centroids_k <= max_uint8_centroids (256) and nprobe <= nlist.
value.how_it_is_checked: ProductQuantizedIvfIndex.fit and NodeGrid.is_applicable reject non-divisible dimensions, out-of-range codebooks and invalid probe counts.

nouns.title: Guardrail: all Voronoi, PQ codebook and top-R rerank scalars resolve from NodeGrid with zero inline magic literals
nouns.category_reason: Prevents hardcoded index constants and enforces cross-parameter rerank constraints.

value.rule: Resolve nlist, nprobe, subspaces_m, subspace_centroids_k and rerank_top_r from default_grid_spec.json and enforce ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
value.how_it_is_checked: scan_directory_for_hardcoded_values and NodeGrid constraint checks run during make check.

nouns.title: Specification: ProductQuantizedIvfIndex Voronoi partitioning, uint8 PQ encoding and ADC + top-R cascade
nouns.category_reason: Defines coarse quantizer, residual product quantizer, ADC lookup table and exact rerank cascade parameters.

nouns.title: Deterministic residual quantization, M x K_sub ADC lookup tables and top-R exact rerank equations
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model ANN indexing and asymmetric distance lookup equations.

value.residual_equation: r(x) = x - C_{c(x)}, partitioned into M contiguous subvectors r_1(x), ..., r_M(x) in R^{D/M}
value.adc_lookup_equation: d_ADC^2(q, x) = sum_{m=0}^{M-1} LUT_c[m][code_m(x)], where LUT_c[m][k] = ||(q - C_c)_m - U_{m,k}||_2^2

value.name: FAISS IVF-PQ and ANN index cascade
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Implements deterministic k-means++ initialization and Lloyd iterations for coarse Voronoi cells and M residual PQ sub-codebooks.
Stores indexed vectors as compact M-byte uint8 PQ codes inside inverted lists and answers queries via M x K_sub Asymmetric Distance Computation lookup tables plus optional exact top-R reranking.
Benchmarks exact byte compression ratios vs float64/float32 and Recall@k across fast_compact and high_recall grid cells.
does_not: Require C++ extensions, external numerical packages or hardcoded numeric scalars in operational functions.

value.shows: IVF-PQ coarse Voronoi clustering, uint8 residual product quantization, ADC table lookups and exact top-R reranking.
